title: Linear Mock Ticket Fixture
description: Wire form of a single Linear ticket fixture used by LinearMockAdapter (story 1.14). Project-internal; not shared with the runner contracts module.

ticketRef.description: Stable, deterministic reference (e.g. LIN-101). Matches the LinearTicket port shape.

authorIdentity.description: Linear-user identity string (email or Linear user public id). Never a GraphQL DTO.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp. pollNewTickets(since) orders by this field ascending.

labels.description: Flat label tags. Preserved into LinearTicket.labels.
